chunks: Who suggests evil thoughts to the hearts of men --
ai.seo_question: Who is the one that whispers in the hearts of men according to Surah An-Nas?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often linked to the concept of *waswasa* originating from both jinn and humans, with the 'hearts of men' (*sudur an-nas*) referring to the receptive spiritual centers where divine permission allows these whispers to take root. Scholars like Allamah Tabatabai emphasize that this is not merely external temptation but an internal struggle where the ego (*nafs*) collaborates with external forces, necessitating refuge in Allah to purify the heart from these subtle intrusions.
